# `AppStateChange`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Notification that a reconnection changed the active page or state, or resumed an exposure or loop.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, NotifyAppStateChange @0x122a30; guider Camera_ZWO::ScanZWOCams @0xfcde0 (64-bit builds) |

Emitted when reconnection changes the active page or state, or resumes exposure or looping. Emitted by the imager on TCP 4700 (channel I) with page, and by the guider on TCP 4400 (channel G) from its camera-scan path, where the notification can be envelope-only; guider event lines are forwarded onto 4700 by the imager main process, which also installs a local callback for this name. Family: custom; no state or error. APK consumer: none established.

Side effects: Observation only.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"AppStateChange"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `page` | string | if imager producer; the guider notification can omit it | - | Active page name; vocabulary not closed here. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, imager - READ shape, not captured; value invented:

```json
{"Event":"AppStateChange","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","page":"preview"}
```

Event, guider-envelope-only - Guider form (READ shape):

```json
{"Event":"AppStateChange","Timestamp":"1234.123456789"}
```
